groups.name: 説明文:ニュース・交通

items.text: Hello, I'm calling about the projector in Room 204. It stopped working during this morning's presentation. I'll send a technician right away.

analysis.translation: もしもし、204号室のプロジェクターの件でお電話しています。今朝のプレゼンの最中に動かなくなりました。すぐに技術者を送ります。

slash.en: Hello, I'm calling about the projector in Room 204.
slash.ja: もしもし、204号室のプロジェクターの件で電話しています

slash.en: It stopped working during this morning's presentation.
slash.ja: 今朝のプレゼン中に動かなくなりました

slash.en: I'll send a technician right away.
slash.ja: すぐに技術者を送ります

pattern.explanation: 1文目は I (S) 'm calling (V)。about ~ が用件を表します。会話の中心は「設備のトラブルと対応」です。

clauses.text: Hello, I'm calling about the projector in Room 204. It stopped working during this morning's presentation. I'll send a technician right away.

tense.name: 現在進行形・過去形・未来形
tense.explanation: 電話の用件は現在進行形、故障は過去形、対応の申し出は I'll + 動詞で表します。

grammar.explanation: 「~の件で電話する」。Part 3 では冒頭で用件が述べられます。
その場で決めた対応の申し出。次にやることを聞き取る合図になります。
「動かなくなる」。機器の故障の定番表現です。

points.detail: 冒頭で用件、末尾で次の行動が述べられる

paraphrase: The projector broke down in the morning.
A repair person will be dispatched immediately.

phrases.t: Hello,
I'm calling about the projector in Room 204.
It stopped working during this morning's presentation.
I'll send a technician right away.

iu.t: Hello, I'm calling about the projector in Room 204.
It stopped working during this morning's presentation.
I'll send a technician right away.

quiz.question: The caller is reporting a problem with the ______ in Room 204.
quiz.explanation: 冒頭の about the projector in Room 204 から、問題があるのはプロジェクターだと分かります。

items.text: Excuse me, does this train stop at Central Station? No, you need to change at Oak Street. The next train to Central leaves from platform three.

analysis.translation: すみません、この電車はセントラル駅に止まりますか。いいえ、オーク・ストリートで乗り換える必要があります。セントラル行きの次の電車は3番ホームから出ます。

slash.en: Excuse me, does this train stop at Central Station?
slash.ja: すみません、この電車はセントラル駅に止まりますか

slash.en: No, you need to change at Oak Street.
slash.ja: いいえ、オーク・ストリートで乗り換える必要があります

slash.en: The next train to Central leaves from platform three.
slash.ja: セントラル行きの次の電車は3番ホームから出ます

pattern.explanation: does this train (S) stop (V) at Central Station。Yes/No で答えられる質問です。

clauses.text: Excuse me, does this train stop at Central Station? No, you need to change at Oak Street. The next train to Central leaves from platform three.

tense.name: 現在形
tense.explanation: 電車の運行は現在形で述べます。need to + 動詞 で必要なことを伝えています。

grammar.explanation: 「~で乗り換える」。交通案内の頻出表現。
「~する必要がある」。指示を聞き取る合図。
次の列車。次の行動や時刻が問われる。

points.detail: Yes/No の後に具体的な指示が続く

paraphrase: You have to transfer at Oak Street.
The next one to Central departs from track three.

phrases.t: Excuse me,
does this train stop at Central Station?
No,
you need to change at Oak Street.
The next train to Central leaves from platform three.

iu.t: Excuse me, does this train stop at Central Station?
No, you need to change at Oak Street.
The next train to Central leaves from platform three.

quiz.question: The man tells the woman that she needs to ______ at Oak Street.
quiz.explanation: No, you need to change at Oak Street. と言っています。stop は列車側の動作で、乗客に必要なのは乗り換えです。

items.text: I'd like to return this jacket because it's too small. Do you have the receipt with you? Yes, here it is. I bought it last week.

analysis.translation: このジャケットは小さすぎるので返品したいのですが。レシートはお持ちですか。はい、これです。先週買いました。

slash.en: I'd like to return this jacket because it's too small.
slash.ja: 小さすぎるのでこのジャケットを返品したい

slash.en: Do you have the receipt with you?
slash.ja: レシートはお持ちですか

slash.en: Yes, here it is.
slash.ja: はい、これです

slash.en: I bought it last week.
slash.ja: 先週買いました

pattern.explanation: I (S) would like to return (V) this jacket (O)。because 節で理由を添えています。

clauses.text: I'd like to return this jacket because it's too small. Do you have the receipt with you? Yes, here it is. I bought it last week.

tense.name: 助動詞 would・過去形
tense.explanation: would like to ~ は丁寧な希望。買った時期は過去形 bought で述べます。

grammar.explanation: 「~したい」の丁寧な言い方。用件を述べる定番。
「~すぎる」。返品理由の定番(too small / too large)。
店員が必要な物(レシートなど)を確認する質問。

points.detail: 店員の質問が次の展開を示す

paraphrase: The customer wants to bring back a jacket.
She wants a refund for an item that doesn't fit.

phrases.t: I'd like to return this jacket
because it's too small.
Do you have the receipt with you?
Yes, here it is.
I bought it last week.

iu.t: I'd like to return this jacket because it's too small.
Do you have the receipt with you?
Yes, here it is.
I bought it last week.

quiz.question: The woman wants to return the jacket because it is too ______.
quiz.explanation: because it's too small と理由を述べています。値段・古さ・色は言っていません。

items.text: Are you attending the sales meeting on Friday? I'd like to, but I have to visit a client in Boston. Then I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.

analysis.translation: 金曜日の営業会議に出席しますか。出たいのですが、ボストンの顧客を訪問しなければなりません。それなら、会議のメモを後で送りますね。

slash.en: Are you attending the sales meeting on Friday?
slash.ja: 金曜日の営業会議に出席しますか

slash.en: I'd like to, but I have to visit a client in Boston.
slash.ja: 出たいのですが、ボストンの顧客を訪問しなければなりません

slash.en: Then I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.
slash.ja: では、会議のメモを後で送りますね

pattern.explanation: Are you (S) attending (V) the sales meeting (O)。近い予定を現在進行形でたずねています。

clauses.text: Are you attending the sales meeting on Friday? I'd like to, but I have to visit a client in Boston. Then I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.

elements.note: 予定を表す現在進行形

tense.name: 現在進行形・未来形
tense.explanation: 予定は現在進行形、申し出は I'll + 動詞。have to は義務を表します。

grammar.explanation: to の後ろの attend が省略されています。断る前置きとして頻出。
「~しなければならない」。出席できない理由を述べる。
次の行動の申し出。最後の発言で問われやすい。

points.detail: 出席できない理由と代案を聞き取る

paraphrase: He cannot come because of a client visit.
She will share the minutes after the meeting.

phrases.t: Are you attending the sales meeting on Friday?
I'd like to,
but I have to visit a client in Boston.
Then I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.

iu.t: Are you attending the sales meeting on Friday?
I'd like to, but I have to visit a client in Boston.
Then I'll send you the meeting notes afterward.

quiz.question: The man cannot attend the meeting because he has to ______ a client.
quiz.explanation: I have to visit a client in Boston. が理由です。

items.text: Our flight has been delayed by two hours. Then we should let the hotel know that we will arrive late. I'll call them from the airport.

analysis.translation: 私たちの便が2時間遅れています。それならホテルに遅れて到着することを知らせたほうがいいですね。空港から電話します。

slash.en: Our flight has been delayed by two hours.
slash.ja: 便が2時間遅れています

slash.en: Then we should let the hotel know that we will arrive late.
slash.ja: ではホテルに遅れて着くと知らせるべきです

slash.en: I'll call them from the airport.
slash.ja: 空港から電話します

pattern.explanation: Our flight (S) has been delayed (V)。by two hours は差を表す修飾語句です。

clauses.text: Our flight has been delayed by two hours. Then we should let the hotel know that we will arrive late. I'll call them from the airport.

tense.name: 現在完了・受動態
tense.explanation: 遅延は have been delayed。次の行動は should と I'll で述べます。

grammar.explanation: 「人に~させる/知らせる」。let the hotel know = ホテルに知らせる。
差の大きさ。by two hours = 2時間分。
提案を表す。次の行動の合図。

paraphrase: The flight is running two hours behind.
They need to notify the hotel.

phrases.t: Our flight
has been delayed
phrases.f: 動詞句(現在完了の受動態)

phrases.t: by two hours.
Then we should let the hotel know that we will arrive late.
I'll call them from the airport.

iu.t: Our flight has been delayed by two hours.
Then we should let the hotel know that we will arrive late.
I'll call them from the airport.

quiz.question: The speakers agree to ______ the hotel about their late arrival.
quiz.explanation: let the hotel know が notify にあたります。実際の連絡は I'll call them で行います。

items.text: Have you reviewed the budget proposal yet? Not yet, I've been busy with the quarterly report. Could you finish it by Wednesday?

analysis.translation: 予算案はもう確認しましたか。まだです、四半期報告書で忙しくて。水曜日までに終えてもらえますか。

slash.en: Have you reviewed the budget proposal yet?
slash.ja: 予算案はもう確認しましたか

slash.en: Not yet, I've been busy with the quarterly report.
slash.ja: まだです、四半期報告書で忙しくて

slash.en: Could you finish it by Wednesday?
slash.ja: 水曜日までに終えてもらえますか

pattern.explanation: Have you (S) reviewed (V) the budget proposal (O) yet。完了したかをたずねています。

clauses.text: Have you reviewed the budget proposal yet? Not yet, I've been busy with the quarterly report. Could you finish it by Wednesday?

tense.name: 現在完了形
tense.explanation: yet の質問と Not yet の応答。I've been busy は状態の継続を表す現在完了です。

grammar.explanation: 「~までに」。期限は設問で問われやすい。
依頼。最後の依頼が会話の要点になることが多い。
「~で忙しい」

paraphrase: She hasn't looked at the proposal yet.
She is asked to complete it before Wednesday.

phrases.t: Have you reviewed
the budget proposal
yet?
Not yet,
I've been busy with the quarterly report.
Could you finish it by Wednesday?

iu.t: Have you reviewed the budget proposal yet?
Not yet, I've been busy with the quarterly report.
Could you finish it by Wednesday?

quiz.question: The man asks the woman to finish the work by ______.
quiz.explanation: 最後の Could you finish it by Wednesday? が依頼の内容です。

items.text: Welcome to Greenfield Bank. How can I help you today? I'd like to open a savings account.

analysis.translation: グリーンフィールド銀行へようこそ。本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか。普通預金口座を開設したいのですが。

slash.en: Welcome to Greenfield Bank.
slash.ja: グリーンフィールド銀行へようこそ

slash.en: How can I help you today?
slash.ja: 本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか

slash.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
slash.ja: 普通預金口座を開設したいのですが

pattern.explanation: I (S) would like to open (V) a savings account (O)。窓口での用件の言い方です。

clauses.text: Welcome to Greenfield Bank. How can I help you today? I'd like to open a savings account.

tense.name: 助動詞 would
tense.explanation: How can I help you? に対し、I'd like to ~ で用件を述べます。

grammar.explanation: 窓口の定番の質問。直後の発言に用件が出る。
用件を述べる定番。何をしたいのかが設問で問われる。
「口座を開く」

points.detail: bank に関する語(account / deposit / withdraw)

paraphrase: The customer wants to set up an account.
She would like to start a savings account.

phrases.t: Welcome to Greenfield Bank.
How can I help you today?
I'd like to open a savings account.

iu.t: Welcome to Greenfield Bank.
How can I help you today?
I'd like to open a savings account.

quiz.question: The customer would like to open a savings ______.
quiz.explanation: a savings account と言っています。

items.text: The copy machine on this floor is out of order again. Let's use the one in the mailroom instead. Good idea, I'll put up a sign for everyone.

analysis.translation: このフロアのコピー機がまた故障しています。代わりにメールルームのものを使いましょう。いい考えですね、みんなに知らせる貼り紙を出します。

slash.en: The copy machine on this floor is out of order again.
slash.ja: このフロアのコピー機がまた故障しています

slash.en: Let's use the one in the mailroom instead.
slash.ja: 代わりにメールルームのものを使いましょう

slash.en: Good idea, I'll put up a sign for everyone.
slash.ja: いい考えですね、みんなに貼り紙を出します

pattern.explanation: The copy machine (S) is (V) out of order (C)。「故障中」という状態です。

clauses.text: The copy machine on this floor is out of order again. Let's use the one in the mailroom instead. Good idea, I'll put up a sign for everyone.

elements.text: The copy machine on this floor

tense.name: 現在形・未来形
tense.explanation: 故障は現在形、提案は Let's、申し出は I'll で表します。

grammar.explanation: 「故障中」。貼り紙の文言としても頻出。
提案。次の行動を示す。
「貼り紙を出す」

vocab.toeic: The machine is out of order.

points.detail: out of order / broken / not working
提案への同意と申し出

paraphrase: The copier on this floor isn't working.
He will post a notice about it.

phrases.t: The copy machine on this floor
is out of order
again.
Let's use the one in the mailroom instead.
Good idea, I'll put up a sign for everyone.

iu.t: The copy machine on this floor is out of order again.
Let's use the one in the mailroom instead.
Good idea, I'll put up a sign for everyone.

quiz.question: The woman offers to put up a ______ for everyone.
quiz.explanation: I'll put up a sign for everyone. と言っています。

items.text: Attention, passengers. Flight 208 to Seattle is now boarding at Gate 12. Please have your boarding pass ready.

analysis.translation: 乗客の皆様にお知らせします。シアトル行き208便は、12番ゲートで搭乗を開始しています。搭乗券をご用意ください。

slash.en: Attention, passengers.
slash.ja: 乗客の皆様にお知らせします

slash.en: Flight 208 to Seattle is now boarding at Gate 12.
slash.ja: シアトル行き208便は12番ゲートで搭乗中です

slash.en: Please have your boarding pass ready.
slash.ja: 搭乗券をご用意ください

pattern.explanation: Flight 208 to Seattle (S) is boarding (V)。アナウンスの中心情報です。

clauses.text: Attention, passengers. Flight 208 to Seattle is now boarding at Gate 12. Please have your boarding pass ready.

tense.name: 現在進行形・命令文
tense.explanation: 今行われていることは現在進行形、依頼は Please + 動詞の原形で述べます。

grammar.explanation: 「~を用意しておく」。聞き手への指示。
対象者への呼びかけ → 状況 → 依頼、の順。最後の依頼が問われやすい。

points.detail: 聞き手への依頼を聞き取る

paraphrase: Passengers can board Flight 208 now.
Passengers should get their tickets ready.

phrases.t: Attention, passengers.
Flight 208 to Seattle
is now boarding
at Gate 12.
Please have your boarding pass ready.

iu.t: Attention, passengers.
Flight 208 to Seattle is now boarding at Gate 12.
Please have your boarding pass ready.

quiz.question: The announcement asks passengers to have their ______ ready.
quiz.explanation: Please have your boarding pass ready. が依頼の内容です。

items.text: Hello, this is Karen from Dr. Lee's office. I'm calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten A.M. Please call us back if you need to reschedule.

analysis.translation: こんにちは、リー医師の診療所のカレンです。明日の午前10時のご予約を確認するためにお電話しました。変更が必要でしたら、折り返しお電話ください。

slash.en: Hello, this is Karen from Dr. Lee's office.
slash.ja: リー医師の診療所のカレンです

slash.en: I'm calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten A.M.
slash.ja: 明日午前10時のご予約を確認するために電話しました

slash.en: Please call us back if you need to reschedule.
slash.ja: 変更が必要なら折り返しお電話ください

pattern.explanation: I (S) 'm calling (V)。to confirm ~ が電話の目的を表します。

clauses.text: Hello, this is Karen from Dr. Lee's office. I'm calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten A.M. Please call us back if you need to reschedule.

tense.name: 現在進行形・命令文
tense.explanation: 目的は I'm calling to ~、依頼は Please + 動詞。if 節は条件を表します。

grammar.explanation: 留守電の定番。目的が最初の設問で問われる。
「折り返し電話する」。依頼の内容として頻出。
条件。if you need to ~ は「~する必要があれば」

points.detail: 電話の目的と依頼を聞き取る

paraphrase: The caller wants to verify an appointment.
Patients should phone to change the time.

phrases.t: Hello,
this is Karen from Dr. Lee's office.
I'm calling to confirm your appointment
tomorrow at ten A.M.
Please call us back if you need to reschedule.

iu.t: Hello, this is Karen from Dr. Lee's office.
I'm calling to confirm your appointment tomorrow at ten A.M.
Please call us back if you need to reschedule.

quiz.question: The caller is phoning to ______ an appointment.
quiz.explanation: I'm calling to confirm your appointment と目的を述べています。

items.text: Thank you for visiting our factory today. Before we begin the tour, please put on a safety helmet. The tour will take about forty minutes.

analysis.translation: 本日は当工場にお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。見学を始める前に、安全ヘルメットをかぶってください。見学は約40分かかります。

slash.en: Thank you for visiting our factory today.
slash.ja: 本日は当工場にお越しいただきありがとうございます

slash.en: Before we begin the tour, please put on a safety helmet.
slash.ja: 見学を始める前に、安全ヘルメットをかぶってください

slash.en: The tour will take about forty minutes.
slash.ja: 見学は約40分かかります

pattern.explanation: The tour (S) will take (V) about forty minutes (O)。take は「(時間が)かかる」の意味です。

clauses.text: Thank you for visiting our factory today. Before we begin the tour, please put on a safety helmet. The tour will take about forty minutes.

tense.name: 未来形・命令文
tense.explanation: 前置きの後、依頼は Please + 動詞、見通しは will で述べます。

grammar.explanation: 「~する前に」。時間順の指示を示す。

The tour will take about forty minutes.

iu.t: Thank you for visiting our factory today.
Before we begin the tour, please put on a safety helmet.
The tour will take about forty minutes.

quiz.question: Before the tour begins, visitors should put on a safety ______.
quiz.explanation: please put on a safety helmet と指示しています。

items.text: This weekend only, all kitchen appliances are thirty percent off. Visit our store on Main Street or order online. The sale ends Sunday at midnight.

The sale ends Sunday at midnight.

iu.t: This weekend only, all kitchen appliances are thirty percent off.
Visit our store on Main Street or order online.
The sale ends Sunday at midnight.

quiz.question: The sale on kitchen appliances ends on ______.
quiz.explanation: The sale ends Sunday at midnight. とあるので、終了は日曜日の深夜です。

items.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm pleased to announce that our new branch will open in Denver next month. Please welcome Mr. Evans, who will be the manager.

analysis.translation: 皆さん、おはようございます。来月デンバーに新しい支店が開設されることをお知らせできて嬉しく思います。支店長を務めるエバンスさんを歓迎してください。

slash.en: Good morning, everyone.
slash.ja: 皆さん、おはようございます

slash.en: I'm pleased to announce that our new branch will open in Denver next month.
slash.ja: 来月デンバーに新支店が開くことをお知らせできて嬉しいです

時期。設問で問われやすい。

Please welcome Mr. Evans,

iu.t: Good morning, everyone.
